import os, sys, copy, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-mh2ird7e/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_wqvqan4x")
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(29511+ws)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = copy.deepcopy(model)
    ids = torch.randint(0,100,(4,8)); tg = torch.randint(0,100,(4,8))
    inputs = list(ids.chunk(2)); targets = list(tg.chunk(2))
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    for i,t in zip(inputs,targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(i).logits.reshape(-1,100), t.reshape(-1))/2; l.backward()
    maxd=0; n=0
    for (nm,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n+=1; maxd=max(maxd,(p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(ws, rank, "loss", loss, "params w/ grad", n, "maxdiff", maxd)
    dist.destroy_process_group()

for ws in (1,2):
    mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
